arxiv-2101-04954.title: EventAnchor: Reducing Human Interactions in Event Annotation of Racket Sports Videos Conference: CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 8–13, 2021; Yokohama, Japan CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems (CHI ’21), May 8–13, 2021, Yokohama, Japan Price: 15.00 DOI: 10.
arxiv-2101-04954.creator: Dazhen Deng, Jiang Wu, Jiachen Wang, Yihong Wu, Xiao Xie, Zheng Zhou, Hui Zhang, Xiaolong (Luke) Zhang, Yingcai Wu
arxiv-2101-04954.description: Abstract . The popularity of racket sports (e.g., tennis and table tennis) leads to high demands for data analysis, such as notational analysis, on player performance. While sports videos offer many benefits for such analysis, retrieving accurate information from sports videos could be challenging.

arxiv-2101-11703.title: Unified Feature Extraction Framework based on Contrastive Learning
arxiv-2101-11703.creator: Hongjie Zhang, Wenwen Qiang, Jinxin Zhang, and Ling Jing
arxiv-2101-11703.description: Abstract Feature extraction is an efficient approach for alleviating the issue of dimensionality in high-dimensional data. As a popular self-supervised learning method, contrastive learning has recently garnered considerable attention. In this study, we proposed a unified framework based on a new perspective of contrastive learning (CL) that is suitable for both unsupervised and supervised feature extraction.

arxiv-2204-00831.title: Estimation of the Star Formation Rate of Galaxies with Radio Continuum Obtained with Murchison Widefield Array
arxiv-2204-00831.creator: Tsutomu T. Takeuchi Shuntaro A. Yoshida, Luca Cortese, O. Ivy Wong, Barbara Catinella, and Suchetha Cooray †
arxiv-2204-00831.description: A 2022 arXiv research paper by Tsutomu T. Takeuchi Shuntaro A. Yoshida, Luca Cortese, O. Ivy Wong, Barbara Catinella, and Suchetha Cooray †. We investigate the correlation between the integrated low-frequency and infrared (IR) emissions of star-forming galaxies extracted from the Herschel Reference Survey.

arxiv-2301-05722.title: ULYSSES , Universal LeptogeneSiS Equation Solver: version 2 Journal: Computer Physics Communications
arxiv-2301-05722.creator: A. Granelli, C. Leslie, Y. F. Perez-Gonzalez, H. Schulz, B. Shuve, J. Turner, R. Walker
arxiv-2301-05722.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by A. Granelli, C. Leslie, Y. F. Perez-Gonzalez, H. Schulz, B. Shuve, J. Turner, R. Walker. ULYSSES is a Python package that calculates the baryon asymmetry produced from leptogenesis in the context of a type-I seesaw mechanism. In this release, the new features include code which solves the Boltzmann equations for low-scale leptogenesis; the complete Boltzmann equations for thermal leptogenesis applying proper quantum statistics without assuming kinetic equilibrium of the right-handed neutrinos; and, primordial black hole-induced leptogenesis.

arxiv-2305-13729.title: Discrete Prompt Optimization via Constrained Generation for Zero-shot Re-ranker
arxiv-2305-13729.creator: Sukmin Cho, Soyeong Jeong, Jeongyeon Seo, Jong C. Park
arxiv-2305-13729.description: Abstract Re-rankers, which order retrieved documents with respect to the relevance score on the given query, have gained attention for the information retrieval (IR) task. Rather than fine-tuning the pre-trained language model (PLM), the large-scale language model (LLM) is utilized as a zero-shot re-ranker with excellent results.

arxiv-2405-15896.title: Enhancing Augmentative and Alternative Communication with Card Prediction and Colourful Semantics
arxiv-2405-15896.creator: Jayr Pereira, Francisco Rodrigues, Jaylton Pereira, Cleber Zanchettin Robson Fidalgo
arxiv-2405-15896.description: Abstract This paper presents an approach to enhancing Augmentative and Alternative Communication (AAC) systems by integrating Colourful Semantics (CS) with transformer-based language models specifically tailored for Brazilian Portuguese. We introduce an adapted BERT model, BERTptCS, which incorporates the CS framework for improved prediction of communication cards.

arxiv-2406-10935.title: Pick-or-Mix: Dynamic Channel Sampling for ConvNets
arxiv-2406-10935.creator: Ashish Kumar †, Daneul Kim ‡, Jaesik Park ‡, Laxmidhar Behera †
arxiv-2406-10935.description: Abstract Channel pruning approaches for convolutional neural networks (ConvNets) deactivate the channels, statically or dynamically, and require special implementation. In addition, channel squeezing in representative ConvNets is carried out via 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolutions which dominates a large portion of computations and network parameters.

arxiv-2407-03606.title: Decoding Analog Subspace Codes: Algorithms for Character-Polynomial Codes Thanks: This work was supported by NSF under Grant CCF-2415440 and the Center for Ubiquitous Connectivity (CUbiC) under the JUMP 2.0 program.
arxiv-2407-03606.creator: Samin Riasat and Hessam Mahdavifar
arxiv-2407-03606.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Samin Riasat and Hessam Mahdavifar. We propose efficient minimum-distance decoding and list-decoding algorithms for a certain class of analog subspace codes, referred to as character-polynomial (CP) codes, recently introduced by Soleymani and the second author. In particular, a CP code without its character can be viewed as a subcode of a Reed–Solomon (RS) code, where a certain subset of the coefficients of the message polynomial is set to zeros.

arxiv-2410-04100.title: Swimmer-Types of Optimum Surface-Driven Active Particles
arxiv-2410-04100.creator: Rafe Md Abu Zayed 1, Arezoo M. Ardekani 2, Amir Nourhani 1,3,4
arxiv-2410-04100.description: Abstract An optimal microswimmer with a given geometry has a surface velocity profile that minimizes energy dissipation for a given swimming speed. An axisymmetric swimmer can be puller-, pusher-, or neutral-type depending on the sign of the stresslet strength. We numerically investigate the type of optimal surface-driven active microswimmers using a minimum dissipation theorem for optimum microswimmers.

arxiv-2507-19107.title: Quasinormal modes of noncommutative geometry-inspired dirty black holes
arxiv-2507-19107.creator: Davide Batic, Denys Dutykh, Zeinabou Ahmed Babou
arxiv-2507-19107.description: Abstract We investigate the quasinormal modes (QNMs) of noncommutative geometry-inspired dirty black holes, focusing on both non-extremal and extremal configurations. These gravitational objects, characterized by smeared energy distributions within a modified de Sitter-like equation of state, modify the classical Schwarzschild metric and regularize central singularities.

arxiv-2508-20698.title: Electric-field metrology of a terahertz frequency comb using Rydberg atoms
arxiv-2508-20698.creator: Wiktor Krokosz, Jan Nowosielski, Bartosz Kasza, Sebastian Borówka, Mateusz Mazelanik, Wojciech Wasilewski, Michał Parniak
arxiv-2508-20698.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Wiktor Krokosz, Jan Nowosielski, Bartosz Kasza, Sebastian Borówka, Mateusz Mazelanik, Wojciech Wasilewski, Michał Parniak. Terahertz radiation finds an increasing number of applications, yet efficient generation and detection remain a challenge and an active area of research. In particular, the precise detection of weak and narrowband terahertz signals is notoriously difficult. Here, we employ a novel type of single-photon detector based on Rydberg atoms to both detect and calibrate a terahertz frequency comb over an octave-spanning range, yet with a MHz-level selectivity.

Methods: This study utilized cross-sectional survey data.

A person is required to obtain a sample pot from a healthcare location, return home and wait until they have a bowel motion, and then deal with the challenges of returning the sample to the clinic or pathology centre.

uslaw-usc-t10-s505.title: 10 U.S.C. § 505 — Regular components: qualifications, term, grade
uslaw-usc-t10-s505.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t10-s505.description: United States Code, Title 10 (Armed Forces); Part II (Personnel); Chapter 31 (Enlistments). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. (a) The Secretary concerned may accept original enlistments in the Regular Army, Regular Navy, Regular Air Force, Regular Marine Corps, or Regular Coast Guard, as the case may be, of qualified, effective, and able-bodied persons who are not less than seventeen years of age.

uslaw-usc-t29-s101.title: 29 U.S.C. § 101 — Issuance of restraining orders and injunctions; limitation; public policy
uslaw-usc-t29-s101.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t29-s101.description: United States Code, Title 29 (Labor); Chapter 6 (Jurisdiction Of Courts In Matters Affecting Employer And Employee). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. No court of the United States, as defined in this chapter, shall have jurisdiction to issue any restraining order or temporary or permanent injunction in a case involving or growing out of a labor dispute, except in a strict conformity.
